balls.text: full toss outside off stump. Bishnoi has a slog at it and clogs it badly towards long on, and gets a couple of runs
very full delivery just outside off stump. Bishnoi backs away and drives it towards deep cover point, where Ellis misfields and ends up conceding three

and he perishes first ball too! Shahrukh with more nifty footwork on the fence! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Yudhvir stands tall and flat-bats it towards long on. Shahrukh judges it to perfection, catches it, flicks it up into the air as he loses balance before coming back in and completing the catch!

Curran has another! Full delivery on middle and off stump. It seems to be in the slot but was perhaps just full enough to not allow Gowtham to get under it completely. Gets decent power but not enough elevation, arrowing it straight down long off's throat in the process!
dug into the track outside off stump. Badoni opens up his stance and hoicks it away towards deep mid wicket. Just a single, though
excellent yorker just outside off stump. Badoni can't get his bat down in time as the ball fizzes underneath his bat
slower yorker that slips out of Curran's hands and is sprayed way outside off stump. Left alone by Badoni and called a wide by the umpire!

back of a length delivery angled into off stump. Badoni plays all over it as the ball pings off the thigh pad towards short third man. Arshdeep wanted the review but Jitesh convinced him that it was too high, rightly so!
dug into the track on leg stump. Gowtham gets inside the line of the ball and helps it on the bounce to fine leg

holes out to long on! Back of a length delivery on off stump that seems to hold in the surface just a tad. Rahul stands tall and tries to go over long on but does not get the timing he is after. Clinks it towards long on, where Ellis does the rest! A 74-run contribution from Rahul but the jury will be out on his strike rate (yet again)!
low full toss on middle and leg stump. Rahul gets his front foot out of the way and powers it towards long on for a couple of runs
clever! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rahul backs away, uses the pace and glides it over short third man for four!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Badoni gets up on his toes and knocks it past the bowler for a single
dug into the track on off stump. Badoni gets onto the back foot and pulls it away towards deep backward square leg

back of a length delivery on leg stump. Stoinis shuffles across and looks to help it fine. He seems to miss it but Curran thinks there is bat or glove involved. He thinks about it before reviewing eventually! That looks pretty close to the glove, although it is very difficult to tell whether it has grazed the glove without UltraEdge. A massive spike as the ball is next to the glove, and Stoinis has to go! Excellent review by Curran, and PBKS have another!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rahul goes back and chops it towards short third man for just another single
dug into the track outside off stump. This one also loops over the batter's head, and this time, the square leg umpire calls it wide
full delivery on leg stump. Stoinis walks right across his stumps and tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
low full toss on off stump. Rahul clears his front leg and drills it down the ground for a single
full delivery angled across the batter outside off stump. Rahul lets it go but that one slides just inside the tramlines
slower yorker on off stump. Stoinis comes forward and defends it back to the bowler
dropped! Length delivery outside off stump. Rahul gives it the lot and drills it back to Rabada, who cannot react in time and puts it down

slower bumper that goes awry and balloons over the batter's head. Left alone by Rahul but not called a wide by the umpire. Reviewed by Rahul! The third umpire reckons that it would have gone above Rahul's head, even if he was in an upright position. Called a wide!
just clears deep point! Slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Rahul throws the kitchen sink at it and scythes it over the sweeper!
slower delivery on a back of a length on off stump. Stoinis goes back and dabs it towards backward point for one more run
low full toss on leg stump. Rahul toe-ends his flick and hits it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
length delivery just outside off stump. Rahul is early into his stroke and chunks it towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rahul has a swish at it and gets a thick outside edge that lands just in front of the diving Rabada at short third
safe! Tossed up on a full length outside off stump. Stoinis throws his hands at it and slices it just over backward point for a single

six more! The perfect two-card trick from Stoinis! Chahar drops it short, anticipating Stoinis going downtown and that is just what the batter is waiting for! Swings at it and smokes it over wide long on!
clears the fence! Flighted again at the stumps but this one lands right in the slot. Stoinis plants his front foot and pumps it over the bowler's head!
tossed up on a full length outside off stump. Stoinis has a massive slog at it but only connects with the fresh Lucknow air
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Rahul goes back and chops it into the off side for just another single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that nips back sharply. Stoinis is cut in half and might have copped a blow on the back thigh for his troubles
angled into the stumps on a full length . Stoinis comes forward and flicks it towards short mid wicket
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Stoinis gets up on his toes and meets it right under his eyes

Pooran departs for a duck! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump that seems to stick in the surface. Pooran tries to mow it over deep mid wicket but does not get hold of it enough. It skews off the bottom part of the bat and Shahrukh does the rest on the deep mid wicket fence!

back of a length delivery that slides down the leg side. Pooran does not get bat on it as the umpire calls it a wide. Rabada, though, wants this to be reviewed, and he gets his way! Nothing on Ultra Edge, though, and the wide call stands!

taken excellently at deep mid wicket! Dug into the track outside off stump. Pandya looks to smash it over deep mid wicket but does not quite get it out of the middle. He hits it off the bottom part of the bat and it arrows towards Shahrukh on the deep mid wicket fence. He catches it and then realises that he will step on the boundary rope. Shows wonderful awareness to flick it up into the air, go outside the field of play and complete the catch after coming back!
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Pandya has a swipe across the line and gets a top edge that bobbles down to third man
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rahul gives himself a bit of room and dabs it down to short third man
length delivery outside off stump. Pandya comes down the track and punches it towards deep cover point for one more run
short delivery on leg stump. Rahul gets onto the back foot and pulls it away towards deep backward square leg for a single
ripper! Length delivery on off stump that grips and spins away sharply. Rahul is squared up completely and beaten all ends up
full delivery outside off stump. Rahul opens his bat face and slices it towards short third man. He sets off for the single but this time, Pandya sends him back
in the slot on middle and off stump. Rahul plants his front foot and bangs it over the bowler's head for four! Gets to fifty too, his first this season!
full delivery way outside off stump. Left alone by Rahul, and Pandya, for some reason, wanders down the track, only to be sent back
slower delivery on a full length just outside off stump. Rahul jabs it towards deep cover point for a single
sharp bumper on leg stump. Rahul looks to upper cut but it is cramped for room. Can't make contact in the end
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Pandya is way too early into the stroke and shanks it towards deep mid wicket
yorker just outside off stump. Rahul gets his bat down in time and squirts it off the inside edge into the leg side for a single
shot! Fractionally short on middle and leg stump. Rahul picks up the length early, gives himself a bit of room and swats it over mid on for four!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Rahul gets up on his toes and defends towards backward point
full delivery on middle and off stump. Pandya pokes it back to the bowler
full delivery just outside off stump. Rahul plants his front foot and drives it towards the sweeper at deep cover point
short and wide outside off stump. Rahul cuts it towards deep cover point and scampers back for a couple of runs
full delivery on middle and off stump. Pandya gets down on one knee and drags it towards deep backward square leg for one
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rahul has a heave at it but cloths it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery outside off stump, which is a riposte to Pandya advancing. He taps it into the off side and collects a single
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Pandya waits in his crease and pushes it into the off side for one
four more! Length delivery way outside off stump. Pandya throws his hands at it and slices it over backward point for another boundary!
full and darted down the leg side. Pandya gets inside the line just in time and tickles it past the keeper for a boundary! Oh dear, looks like Raza has overstepped!
back of a length delivery outside off stump that skids through. Pandya looks for the cut but is late on it, and ends up missing it
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Rahul drops it into the on side and ambles across to the other end
full delivery on middle and off stump. Rahul comes forward and places it into the vast real estate on the leg side for a couple of runs
full and fired into middle and off stump. Pandya advances and works it into the leg side for a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Pandya takes a step down the track and stabs it towards mid off for a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Pandya gets behind the line of the ball and meets it with a straight bat
shot! Banged into the track outside off stump. Pandya gets on top of the bounce and hammers it past deep backward square leg for four!
length delivery in the channel that nips away ever so slightly. Pandya has a nibble at it and is beaten all ends up
short delivery outside off stump. Rahul gets up on his toes and cuts it towards backward point for a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Rahul waits deep in his crease, uses the pace and threads it between backward point and short third man for four!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Rahul gets onto the back foot and punches it down the ground for one more run
full delivery at the stumps. Pandya comes forward and pushes it past the bowler for a single

huge appeal, and that looks pretty adjacent! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump that skids through. Hooda opens up his stance and looks to go over cow corner but is beaten by the extra pace and the slight lack of bounce. The ball pins him on the back leg, right in front of the stumps and Hooda, rightly does not even bother with the review!
short on leg stump. Rahul goes back and pulls it away towards short fine leg for one more run
edged and four! Back of a length delivery on off stump. Rahul backs away and throws his hands at it, getting a thick outside edge that dribbles past short third man
full delivery outside off stump. Rahul plants his front foot and flicks it towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
full delivery angled into the stumps. Hooda comes down the track and chips it neatly over extra cover. Raza runs across to his left from long off and cuts it off
flighted on a full length outside off stump. Hooda lunges forward and pokes it towards short extra cover

holes out to deep backward square leg! Dragged down on leg stump, and Mayers could have hit that literally anywhere. This one, though, just sticks in the surface a little and Mayers it early into the stroke. He toe-ends it straight down deep backward square leg's throat, who makes no mistake!
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Mayers pats it back to the bowler
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Mayers looks to force it through the off side but can only chunk it off the inside edge into his pads
full and wide outside off stump. Rahul reaches out for it and pushes it towards deep cover point for one
very full delivery outside off stump. Rahul squeezes it past the bowler and picks up another single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Mayers gets onto the back foot and cuts it towards deep point for one more run
short and wide outside off stump. Rahul cuts it towards deep point and picks up a single
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Rahul does not have room to work with again and helps it round the corner towards short fine leg
length delivery angled into middle and off stump. Rahul presses half forward and taps it towards short mid wicket
length delivery fired outside off stump. Rahul waits in his crease and chops it towards backward point
length delivery on leg stump. Mayers is cramped for room and can only prod it into the off side off the back foot
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Rahul goes back and knocks it down the ground for a single
flighted on a full length outside off stump. Rahul reaches out for it and drives it towards extra cover. Mayers sets off for the single but is sent back in time
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Mayers goes back and punches it towards extra cover, who parries it to mid off and keeps it to one
full delivery on leg stump. Rahul comes forward and flicks it towards mid on for one more run
and he gets greeted with a boundary! Short, wide and thumped! Rahul has all the time in the world to rock back and crack it past extra cover!
full delivery just outside off stump. Mayers looks for the expansive straight drive but ends up shanking it towards mid on
big shot! Dug into the track on leg stump. Mayers picks up the length early, rocks back and dumps it over the deep square leg fence!
full delivery outside off stump. Mayers clears his front leg and swings for the hills. Does not quite middle it but gets enough bat to clear mid off
yorker on middle and leg stump. Mayers gets his bat down in time and jams it towards mid on
very full delivery outside off stump that shapes away. Rahul digs it out into the off side and saunters across to the other end
back of a length delivery on off stump. Rahul gets up on his toes and defends towards backward point
and just as I type that, Curran drops one short and wide, and gets punished! Too much width and Mayers can just sit back in his crease and carve it over point for six!
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Mayers plants his front foot and drives it straight to the fielder at mid off
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Rahul drops it into the off side and hares across to the other end
slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Mayers hops up onto his toes and runs it down to short third man for one
full delivery on middle and off stump. Mayers hangs back in his crease and stabs it towards mid off
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Rahul goes back and jabs it into the off side for a single
edged! Full delivery on off stump that shapes away just a shade. Rahul looks to work to leg and ends up getting a leading edge down to third man
shot! Length delivery outside off stump. Rahul stands tall on the front foot and effortlessly lifts it over extra cover for four!
oh! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump that rears up. Rahul is not expecting it and cops a blow on the right glove. His hand might have gotten jammed into the bat handle too!
back of a length delivery hung outside off stump. Mayers throws his hands at it and slashes it on the bounce to third man
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Mayers waits in his crease and glides it fine past third man for another boundary!
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Mayers gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side
fuller this time outside off stump. Rahul gets forward confidently and drives nicely. Can't beat the fielder at cover, though
length delivery pushed across the batter outside off stump. Rahul has a long, hard look at it before letting it go
four more! Full delivery that stars on leg stump and swings down the leg side. Rahul gets inside the line early and glances it past short fine leg
full delivery angled across the batter just outside off stump. Rahul goes feeling for it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Mayers opens his bat face and guides it towards short third man. Rahul is intent on the single and gets across comfortably in the end
full delivery on off stump that shapes into Rahul just a touch. He comes forward and pokes it towards mid on for a single
back of a length delivery fired way outside off stump. Left alone by Rahul and called a wide by the umpire
short and wide outside off stump. Mayers gets onto the back foot and punches it straight to the fielder in the ring at cover point
length delivery just outside off stump. Mayers goes back and dabs it into the off side
turn and bounce! Length delivery just outside off stump that grips and rips past Mayers' attempted prod
gets off the mark in style! Full delivery darted down the leg side. Mayers gets inside the line of the ball and heaves it over the deep backward square leg fence!
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Mayers pats it back to the bowler
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Rahul comes forward and eases it down the ground to get off the mark

that will be that! Shahrukh has win this for PBKS! What a knock under pressure! In the slot outside off stump and that is just the sort of delivery Shahrukh is after. He winds up and thumps it to long off's left to seal a nervy two-wicket win for the Punjab Kings!

just short! Length delivery just outside off stump. Shahrukh gets his front foot out of the way again and slugs it, just on the bounce to long on. Excellent effort by Hooda, though, to go for the catch and then stop the boundary!

length delivery on middle and off stump. Shahrukh clears his front leg and swats it towards deep mid wicket. The fielder, after fielding it, admires his collection for a bit and allows the batters to complete the second
back of a length delivery angled into the batter at the stumps. Rabada does not have any room to work with and plonks it back to the bowler

edged and taken! Too hot to handle this time! 147.9 kph thunderbolt that pitches on a length on leg stump and straightens ever so slightly. Brar continues swinging but does so without any foot movement, getting a feather through to the keeper!
what a shot under pressure! Full and slanted into leg stump. Brar gives himself plenty of room and thrashes it past mid off and extra cover for four!
length delivery outside off stump. Shahrukh throws his hands at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg

edged and it flies for six! Banged into the track at the batter. Shahrukh is cramped for room but has a swipe at it anyway. Gets it nowhere close to the middle but gets a top edge that flies way over the keeper's head!
length delivery way outside off stump. Shahrukh leaves it well alone as the umpire calls it a wide
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Brar gets up on his toes and tucks it off his hips towards deep square leg for a single
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Brar comes forward and works it towards deep mid wicket for a single

holes out to deep backward square leg! Bishnoi has another, and this game is turning again! Full delivery hung outside off stump. Raza shuffles across and tries to sweep it over deep backward square leg. He gets a decent piece of it but he is hitting to the longer side. Stoinis runs in off the fence and takes the catch!
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump that skids through. Raza does not pick the googly either, swishing and missing in the process
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Shahrukh gets down on one knee and heaves it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
full delivery on middle and off stump. Shahrukh comes forward and defends it towards short mid wicket

length delivery that slides down the leg side. Shahrukh misses his paddle as the umpire indulges in a bit of exercise. Pooran, though, thinks there is bat involved and convinces his skipper to go upstairs! Nothing on UltraEdge as the ball passes the bat, and LSG have burnt a review!
full delivery just outside off stump. Shahrukh lunges forward and pokes it towards Bishnoi, who pulls out the dive and saves a single
shot! That is a beauty! In the slot outside off stump. Raza takes a step across his stumps, gets his hands through the ball and crunches it past extra cover for four!
full delivery fired way outside off stump. Left alone by Raza and called a wide by the umpire
length delivery just outside off stump. Raza looks for the extravagant scoop and makes a meal of it. Lucky to not lose his off stump in the process!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Shahrukh gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep point for one
full toss outside off stump. Raza winds up and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket for just a single. Raza is livid with himself for having missed out there!
excellent wide yorker. Raza walks across and tries to access the off side but does not make any contact at all

Has Raza run himself out here? Back of a length delivery on off stump. Raza drops it into the off side and immediately calls for two. He turns properly but has to scramble to make his ground. Has he made it? Massive, massive moment in this game! The dive seems to have saved Raza by the skin of his teeth. Millimetres, absolute millimetres in that and Raza lives to tell another tale!
oh, hello! Oh, hello! In the slot outside off stump. Shahrukh asks what the fuss is all about, plants his front foot and clatters it a mile over long on!

what a catch by Rahul! Salutes to the crowd, and Wood has broken this game open! Full delivery just outside off stump. Jitesh comes forward a little tentatively and has a waft at it. He does not middle it at all and the ball clinks off the toe-end towards mid off, where Rahul leaps low to his left and pulls off a sensational catch!
sharp bumper on off stump. Raza takes his eyes off it but manages to swing it away towards deep backward square leg. Maiden IPL fifty for Raza, and this one has come off just 34 balls!

banged into the track on leg stump. Raza gets underneath it and the square leg umpire calls it one bouncer for the over. Raza, though, has reviewed this, arguing that it should be a wide The third umpire has a look at it and reckons it is high enough to be called a wide!
shot! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Raza gets up on his toes, swivels nicely and bisects the gap between deep square leg and fine leg to perfection!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Jitesh shuffles across his stumps and just manages to short-arm jab it over short mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Jitesh goes back and taps it towards short mid wicket
length delivery on middle and off stump. Raza clears his front leg and drags it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs
full delivery outside off stump. Raza lunges forward and blocks it towards short extra cover
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Jitesh goes back and hacks it away towards deep mid wicket for a single

Curran bites the dust! Bishnoi with the breakthrough! Length delivery outside off stump. Curran looks to go downtown but this time, slices it just a touch because of the angle across him. It swirls down to long off, where Pandya settles himself and completes the catch!
short, wide and punished! Too much room and Curran gets his hands through the ball, crashing it over extra cover for a boundary!
googly on a back of a length outside off stump. Curran has a wat at it but is late on the stroke as the ball fizzes past the bat
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Curran hangs back and flat-bats it down the ground for a single
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Raza waits in his crease and punches it towards deep mid wicket for one more run
full delivery on middle and off stump. Curran gets forward and eases it down the ground to get off the mark
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Raza goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket for a single
length delivery darted down the leg side. Left alone by Raza and called a wide by the umpire
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Raza takes a step down the track and prods it towards short mid wicket
four more! Back of a length delivery fired down the leg side. Raza uses the pace and helps it past short fine leg!
length delivery just outside off stump. Curran comes half forward and defends it back to the bowler
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that holds in the surface. Raza goes back and chips it over the bowler's head for a single

four more! The ball is following Yudhvir! Another wretched short delivery and Pandya gets met! All Raza has to do is find the gap between deep mid wicket and long on, and he does so to perfection! Yudhvir might have gotten a fingertip to it, at best!
over Yudhvir again! Short on middle and leg stump. Raza mows it towards deep mid wicket, where Yudhvir tries to palm it back into play but is unable to do so!

dragged down on middle and leg stump. Raza goes deep into his crease and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket. Yudhvir settles himself under the high ball but makes contact with the cushion just as the ball hits his hands!
tossed up on a full length just outside leg stump. Raza swings for the hills but misses. The keeper, too, can't gather cleanly
back of a length delivery on off stump. Raza hangs back and pulls it away towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery that pitches on off stump and spins into Raza. He is cramped for room and plays all over it as the ball hits the thigh pad
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Raza backs away and swishes at it, only connecting with fresh air
breaks the shackles! In the slot on off stump. Raza dances down the track and belts it over the long off fence! Much-needed!
length delivery on middle and off stump. Raza comes down the track and defends it towards the bowler
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Raza stabs it back to the bowler

straight to deep backward square leg! Full delivery on leg stump. Bhatia gets inside the line and heaves at it. He has to reach out in front, though, and does not get the power or the elevation he desires. Arrows it straight to the sweeper, who dives forward and snaffles it up!
full delivery just outside off stump. Raza throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge that bobbles down to short third man
appeal! Length delivery on middle and off stump. Bhatia brings out the reverse sweep and scuffs it into the off side
length delivery on leg stump. Bhatia takes a step down the track before patting it towards short mid wicket
gets it away! Marginally short on middle and off stump. Bhatia backs away, creates room for himself and cuts it over extra cover for four!
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Raza comes onto the front foot and drives it towards long off for a single
length delivery in the channel that grips and spins away sharply. Bhatia has a nibble at it and is beaten comprehensively
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Raza backs away further and punches it down the ground for a single
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Raza goes back and nurdles it into the leg side. Gets back for two quite comfortably
safe! Full delivery outside off stump. Bhatia takes a step down the track and chips it on the bounce to long off
angled into the stumps. Raza advances and works it towards deep mid wicket, where the fielder misfields and concedes the third run

oh dear! Full delivery on middle and off stump. Raza tips it towards the bowler and calls his partner through for the single before saying no and selling him down the river. Gowtham, though, makes an absolute hash of it
length delivery on leg stump. Bhatia nudges it into the vast opens spaces on the leg side and races back for a couple of runs
nearly! Full delivery angled across outside off stump. Bhatia advances and nearly pops it straight back to the bowler
deft! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Bhatia uses the pace on offer and steers it fine past short third man for four!
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Raza clears his front leg and drills it towards long on for one
length delivery on middle and leg stump. The ball grips in the surface a tad and Raza defends it back to the bowler
full and darted outside off stump. Bhatia comes forward and knocks it down the ground for a single
back of a length delivery slanted into the batter on leg stump. Raza hops around in his crease before fending it away towards mid wicket
length delivery just outside off stump. Raza hangs back and plonks it into the off side
back of a length delivery outside off stump that hurries onto the batter. Raza is late on the stroke but manages to flat-bat it down to long on for a brace
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Bhatia gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep cover point
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Raza is squared up completely and plonks it past backward point for a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Bhatia stays leg side of the ball and glides it on the bounce to third man
short delivery on off stump. Bhatia gets onto the back foot and pulls it away towards deep backward square leg
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Raza goes back and nurdles it into the leg side before dashing across to the other end
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Raza gets behind the line of the ball and defends into the off side
length delivery hung outside off stump. Raza has a long, hard look at it before letting it go. That might have been close to being called a wide too
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Bhatia throws his hands at it and slashes it on the bounce to third man
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Bhatia has a nibble at it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge of the bat

and Gowtham gets his man! Full delivery angled across the batter at the stumps. Short thinks about going over mid off initially but then, for some reason, restrains himself. In the end, he chips it straight to mid off and he can't believe what he has done! Gowtham is over the moon, and LSG have three in the powerplay!
full delivery on middle and off stump. Short comes forward and taps it back to the bowler
shot! Length delivery just outside off stump. Short plants his front foot, winds up and launches it over the long on fence!
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Bhatia drops it into the on side and calls his partner through for a relatively comfortable single
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Short knocks it down the ground and canters across to the other end
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Short waits in his crease and stabs it towards extra cover
length delivery on middle and off stump. Bhatia comes half forward and pokes it towards cover point
short delivery outside off stump. Bhatia gets up on his toes and cuts it towards cover point
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Bhatia watches the ball onto his bat and drops it into the off side
back of a length delivery on off stump. Short waits in his crease and hacks it towards deep square leg for one more run
four more! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Short stands up on his toes, gets his hands through the ball and cracks it past cover point!
marginally short on middle and leg stump, and the batter is onto it in a flash! He rocks back and hammers it over mid wicket for four!
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Bhatia goes back and tugs it towards mid wicket
length delivery on middle and leg stump that rushes onto the batter. Short is a tad late on the stroke as the ball pings off the thigh pad into the on side
full delivery just outside off stump. Short presses half forward and pushes it down the ground towards mid off
length delivery just outside off stump. Short comes half forward and jabs it towards backward point
dug into the track outside off stump. Short gets on top of the bounce and pulls it away for another brace
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Short turns it behind square on the leg side and hares back for the second
shot! Full delivery on middle and off stump. Bhatia uses the angle and clips it delightfully over mid on for a boundary!
length delivery just outside off stump. Short has a waft at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards deep mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Short stands up tall and punches it towards mid off
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Bhatia glances it down to fine leg and gets off the mark

oh dear, Prabhsimran can't catch a break, much like the person typing out these comments! Full and slanted into the batter just outside off stump. It pitches and decks back sharply, breezing past Prabhsimran's drive, and sending off stump cartwheeling!
banged into the track outside off stump. Prabhsimran gets into position and heaves it over mid wicket for a much-needed boundary!
length delivery just outside off stump. Short has a prod at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his pads
slower delivery on a length just outside off stump that cuts back in. Short plays down the wrong line and is rapped on the back leg. Too high, though
lovely! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Short stands up tall and absolutely crunches it past cover point for four!
four more! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Short lets the ball come to him before clipping it off his hips through the vacant square leg region!
length delivery just outside off stump. Short presses half forward and taps it towards extra cover
and Short greets him with a boundary! Dragged down outside off stump, and it gives Short the time and the room to whack it past mid wicket
full delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran plants his front foot and stabs it down the ground towards mid off
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran gets up on his toes and defends into the off side
length delivery down the leg side. Short gets inside the line and glances it down to fine leg to get off the mark

edged and taken at third man! What a start for Yudhvir and LSG! Back of a length delivery angled into middle and off stump. Taide looks to break free by swinging it over the leg side but is early into the stroke. The ball skews off the leading edge and flies down to third man, where Avesh completes the catch!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Taide throws his hands at it but is late on the stroke as the ball whizzes past the flailing blade
back of a length delivery on off stump that climbs onto the batter. Taide gets up on his toes and drops it right beside him with relatively soft hands
